name: Media Import
description: Media Import guides administrators through identifying, naming, reviewing, and importing video files into Jellyfin libraries.
overview: Interactive import of films and series into Jellyfin libraries.

versions.changelog: Jellyfin 12 beta targeting RC5 and .NET 10. Includes the complete interactive movie and episode identification, import preview, NFO sidecar, non-overwriting move, and sortable media-detail workflow.

Initial beta with interactive movie and episode identification, reviewable import previews, Jellyfin-standard NFO sidecars, safe non-overwriting file moves, progressive media details, and sortable inbox columns.
